releaseNotes: 0.1.6 (beta): driver 0.1.4 reconnects to the TV by itself within about 30 s after an update; before, it stayed disconnected while showing online. Package names no longer launch apps since a Google Play update in August 2026; use a link the app handles, such as https://www.youtube.com (the README lists links for common apps). Tester 0.3.4 expects the TV to refuse a launch by package name.
